# AEAN Studios

> AEAN Studios is a UK-based creative studio run by Emma Winnard. It mainly offers website design and development, book cover design and social media management, alongside brand identity design, illustration, content creation, YouTube thumbnail design and photography for brands and small businesses. All work is delivered remotely to clients anywhere.

## Services

- [Website Design](https://aeanstudios.com/websites): Custom-coded websites for small businesses, structured for search engines (SEO) and AI answer engines (AEO). From £200 for a single-page site; the price covers design and code only, with domain, hosting and paid third-party tools separate.
- [Social Media Management & Content Creation](https://aeanstudios.com/social-media): Strategy, content planning, content design, captions, scheduling, outreach and community management for businesses, handled end to end.
- [Brand Identity & Logo Design](https://aeanstudios.com/logos): Marks, systems and visual identities built for brands.
- [Photography](https://aeanstudios.com/photography): Image-led brand and campaign photography.
- [YouTube Thumbnails](https://aeanstudios.com/thumbnails): High-impact, click-worthy thumbnail design.
- [Selected Work](https://aeanstudios.com/work): Portfolio of brand identity, illustration, book cover and social content projects.

## About

- [The Studio](https://aeanstudios.com/about): Studio philosophy and background on founder Emma Winnard, graphic designer, illustrator and art director.
